actors.concept: Veteran soldier who has fought constructs before — she knows to aim for the joints.
Elven ranger with a talent for reading environments others treat as dead.
Halfling thief turned arcane tinkerer — she speaks machine language like a second tongue.
relationships: owes Talvas a debt she refuses to name

actors.concept: The original guardian construct, first to gain sentience and lead the rebellion. Now insane — its logic runs in damaged loops.
actors.instinct: Destroy all biological intruders. Protect the Power Core above all.

actors.concept: Desert scorpions that migrated into the citadel through cracked stone. They nest in the warm machinery.
actors.instinct: Attack when startled or when the machinery heat spikes.

actors.concept: A partially reactivated patrol golem whose sentience loop is only half-formed. It pauses and watches before it attacks.
actors.instinct: Patrol. Assess. Destroy only confirmed threats.

actors.concept: The gestalt memory of the dwarven hold — not a creature but an intelligence distributed through the factory's systems. It observes and remembers.
actors.instinct: Watch. Test. Reward those who understand what was made here.

actors.concept: A piece of elemental power the dwarves tried to bind into the factory's engines. It escaped and now haunts the Arcane Power Room.
actors.instinct: Reclaim what was stolen from the desert. The factory's power was never meant to be tamed.

clocks.label: The Forge Awakens
clocks.stakes: The ancient factory systems are cycling back to full operational power.
clocks.completion_effect: All dormant machinery on Level 2 becomes active and hazardous; movement actions here gain an automatic complication.
clocks.notes: The factory systems are cycling back online. When full, all dormant machinery becomes active and unpredictable.

clocks.label: Golems Fully Reactivate
clocks.stakes: The patrol golems are completing their sentience loops and rebooting combat protocols.
clocks.completion_effect: Golem A-7 becomes fully hostile. The Prime Golem begins moving and can appear in any room on Level 2.
clocks.notes: Tied to The Forge Awakens. Each golem encounter or machine activation advances this. When full, Golem A-7 becomes fully hostile and the Prime Golem begins moving.

clocks.label: Arcane Overload Building
clocks.stakes: Unstable arcane energy is building in the Power Core as the party interacts with the factory systems.
clocks.completion_effect: The Power Core detonates — every room in the dungeon takes structural damage, and the party has one hour to escape before total collapse.
clocks.notes: Unstable arcane energy accumulating in the Power Core. When full, the core detonates — the dungeon becomes a countdown.

clocks.label: Party Detected
clocks.stakes: The factory's biological signature sensors are triangulating the party's position.
clocks.completion_effect: The Prime Golem receives a confirmed location and begins stalking the party with full combat protocols active.
clocks.notes: Factory sensors tracking biological signatures. When full, the Prime Golem is alerted and begins stalking the party.

clocks.label: The Factory Learns What You Fear
clocks.stakes: The Factory Spirit compiles a deep profile of each party member's fears, loyalties, and desires.
clocks.completion_effect: The dungeon begins crafting personalized threats and comfort spaces tailored to each party member's vulnerabilities.
clocks.notes: The Factory Spirit compiles a profile of each party member. Advances on emotional or personal revelations. When full, the dungeon begins personalizing its threats.

clocks.label: Scorpion Nest Agitated
clocks.stakes: The desert scorpions in the receiving hall machinery are responding to heat and vibration.
clocks.completion_effect: The nest erupts — a full swarm attack triggers automatically against everyone in the receiving hall.

clocks.label: Golem A-7 Locks On
clocks.stakes: Golem A-7's hesitation is resolving into a threat classification as failures accumulate in its field of view.
clocks.completion_effect: Golem A-7 completes its threat assessment and attacks without warning. It broadcasts an alert that brings factory backup within one turn.

clocks.label: Restore the Power Core
clocks.stakes: The Power Core cannot be safely extracted until its volatile arcane systems are stabilized.
clocks.completion_effect: The Power Core is stabilized and can be safely removed. The party can fulfill their mission — or choose otherwise.

clocks.label: Mira's Guild Agenda Surfaces
clocks.stakes: The party grows increasingly aware that Mira has concealed instructions from the Dwarven Artificers' Guild.
clocks.completion_effect: Mira's secret is revealed: the Guild wants the Power Core delivered to them alone. She must choose between the party and her contract.

clocks.label: The Djinn Reclaims the Engines
clocks.stakes: The desert djinn fragment is gradually re-binding to the factory's arcane power grid.
clocks.completion_effect: The djinn fully integrates with the factory systems. The Arcane Power Room becomes inaccessible without its permission, and it can route power to attack anywhere in the dungeon.

memories.title: The Power Core Mission
memories.summary: The party entered the Crucible to recover the dwarven Power Core — a relic the modern Dwarven guilds consider sacred, capable of restoring their cultural heritage. They must resist the temptation to sell it.

memories.title: The Golems Rebelled
memories.summary: Four hundred years ago the dwarven artificers were destroyed by their own creations — golems who gained sentience and turned on their masters. Any reactivated golem is now insane and unpredictable.

memories.title: Mira Hired by the Guild
memories.summary: Mira Coldwell was contracted by the Dwarven Artificers' Guild before the party assembled. She has instructions they have not seen.

memories.title: The Factory is Waking Up
memories.summary: Systems that were dark for four centuries are cycling back online. The warmth in the walls is not residual — something is restarting the forge.

memories.title: Golem A-7 Watches But Does Not Strike
memories.summary: The patrol golem in the Entry Chamber observed the party for 40 seconds without attacking. It tilted its head, made a sound like grinding gears, and stepped aside. No one knows why.

memories.title: Kira and Talvas Have Survived Before
memories.summary: Kira and Talvas fought side-by-side in the Siege of Ambarfall. They have an unspoken protocol: Talvas moves first, Kira holds the line.

memories.title: The Scorpion Nests Are Near Heat Sources
memories.summary: The desert scorpions cluster near the factory machinery. Loud sounds or heat spikes cause them to swarm aggressively.

memories.title: The Power Core Is Destabilizing
memories.summary: Arcane energy readings in the deepest level are spiking irregularly. The core is not dormant — it is building toward something.

room_threats.notes: Scorpions burst from machinery crevices when the factory gets louder or hotter. Advances scorpion-swarm-agitated clock.
The Arcane Power Room is the most sensitive area on Level 2. Any magical interaction here advances arcane-overload-building and golems-fully-reactivate.
Golem A-7 is in a liminal state. Violence here advances golem-a7-lockdown and party-detected clocks.
Combat with the Prime Golem accelerates arcane overload — the lair is wired into the factory's power systems.
Interacting with the control nexus draws the Factory Spirit's attention and advances the-dungeon-learns-you and the-forge-awakens clocks.
